class.name: OcgBreptoolsQuilt
class.brief_description: A Tool to glue faces at common edges and reconstruct shells.
class.description: ! A Tool to glue faces at common edges and reconstruct shells. ! ! The user designate pairs of common edges using the method Bind. ! One edge is designated as the edge to use in place of the other one ! (they are supposed to be geometrically confused, but this not checked). ! They can be of opposite directions, this is specified by the orientations. ! ! The user can add shapes with the Add method, all the faces are registered and copies of faces ! and edges are made to glue at the bound edges. ! ! The user can call the Shells methods to compute a compound of shells from the current set of ! faces. ! ! If no binding is made this class can be used to make shell from faces already sharing their ! edges.

method.name: Bind_1
method.description: Binds <Enew> to be the new edge instead of <Eold>.

method.name: Bind_2
method.description: Binds <VNew> to be a new vertex instead of <Vold>.

method.name: Add
method.description: Add the faces of <S> to the Quilt, the faces containing bounded edges are copied.

method.name: IsCopied
method.description: Returns True if <S> has been copied (<S> is a vertex, an edge or a face)

method.name: Copy
method.description: Returns the shape substituted to <S> in the Quilt.

method.name: Shells
method.description: Returns a Compound of shells made from the current set of faces. The shells will be flagged as closed or not closed.
